entities.name: Gamelbert of Michaelsbuch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Blessed Gamelbert of Michaelsbuch was an eighth-century Christian priest active in the region of present-day Stephansposching / Michaelsbuch in Bavaria. Remembered as a pastoral founder figure, he is associated with early church organisation in the Danubian mission field during the era when Agilolfing Bavaria was being more tightly integrated into Frankish Christendom and Benedictine monastic networks.

His cult as a beatus reflects local memory of rural priests who planted parishes before full diocesan density. Hagiographic tradition emphasises charity and steadfast ministry rather than high politics, typical of many Germanic regional saints of the early Middle Ages.

Gamelbert thus represents the grassroots Christianisation of Bavaria—the parish priest as holy founder in a landscape still converting from older cults.
